title: The same page, with the light let out
question: You picked the panels page but said it was too white and too gentle, and pointed back at the halo tube - the light that escapes. Same layout, three strengths of that. Pick the level, not the layout.

options.label: The light escapes
options.thesis: Each tube still glows from inside, but the glow now leaks past the channel and pools on the panel beside it. Deeper relief, a cooler ground so the white has something to be white against, and type with real contrast.
options.viewport: The same page, one step louder.
options.risk: The fills are more saturated than the version you approved - close to the 'מצועצע' you rejected two rounds ago.

options.label: The light reaches the numbers
options.thesis: The glow spills across the whole panel, the water throws blue onto its own, and each tube's numbers are tinted with its colour.
options.risk: Coloured type on near-white is the weakest contrast on the screen - the one thing this style reliably gets wrong.

options.label: The tubes are lamps
options.thesis: The light floods out of the channels and washes the panel and the page behind it; the water card is lit blue end to end and the tab button burns.
options.viewport: The top of the screen is a wash of four colours.
options.risk: This is the point where the interface itself becomes coloured, which the library already flagged twice as too strong - and the four colours meet in a rainbow.
